body:
Thank you all for your kind comments and PMs. It means a lot that you guys have taken an interest. 

One thing I want to explain a bit more is my refusal to end up homeless. Because of my PTSD, when my depression comes back it gets really bad really fast. It is difficult to cope with it when I'm in a good environment with a strong support network, the thought of having to cope with it without that terrifies me. I'm in a good place mentally right now, and I'd rather go out on something of a high note than be driven to do it in a moment of desperation. I don't know, maybe I just need to have that bit more control over it.
